name: Moxidectin

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Cutaneous, Ophthalmological and/or Systemic Adverse Reactions of Varying Severity (Mazzotti Reaction ) : This may occur in patients with onchocerciasis following treatment with Moxidectin Tablets. Monitor patients for symptoms, including symptomatic orthostatic hypotension. ( 5.1 )…

summary: Warnings for Moxidectin include severe body-wide reactions affecting the skin and eyes, known as Mazzotti reaction, which may occur in patients treated for a parasitic infection called onchocerciasis [3]. Patients should be watched for symptoms such as low blood pressure that causes dizziness when standing up, known as symptomatic orthostatic hypotension [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than tests on people estimated a medium risk score of 53 for the liver and a low risk score of 28 for the heart [M].
